month_theme: Week 1 of the independent gap year — decisions made, execution begins

must_do.text: Confirm Baret Scholars decline is sent — if not done this weekend, send it Monday morning. Then notify Duke of gap year deferral acceptance.
Say 'update my plan' — career plan Duke revision is 8 weeks overdue. Gap year path is now confirmed, making this the most urgent single task. Everything downstream depends on it.
Open brokerage account — Fidelity or Schwab. Still pending from last week. Get it done.

should_do.text: Begin C++ self-study in earnest — learncpp.com, VSCode + GCC setup, 30 min/day minimum. This is now confirmed gap year Phase 1 work.
Research Coiba scuba certification operators — call or email programs, get pricing and Aug–Dec 2026 availability.

could_do.text: Open Fusion360 and reacquaint with the interface — 30 min to rebuild the muscle memory needed for the glider project.
Start Khan Academy Personal Finance Module 1 — foundations, pairs well with brokerage account opening.

key_dates.event: Week 1 of post-decision execution — Baret decline sent, gap year deferral confirmed
US Independence Day — US contacts mostly offline, plan around it

notes: The two big decisions are locked in: Duke committed (Fall 2027), Baret declined in favor of the independent path. No more deliberation — this week is pure execution. The career plan update is the foundation everything else is built on: Phase 1 milestones, revised internship timeline, Duke Fall 2027 academic plan. It cannot wait another week. Start C++ now — Aug 2026 arrives faster than it feels.
